name: saascity
description: Plan a product launch from your agent: audit a homepage before launch, pick launch directories from 1,600+ with Ahrefs DR, link type and price, and draft a SaaSCity listing (human confirms via claim link before publication).

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No account or API key needed.

examples.title: Pre-launch audit
examples.prompt: Audit https://example.com before I launch it.

examples.title: Pick directories
examples.description: Choose launch directories by DR and link type
examples.prompt: Find free dofollow launch directories with DR above 50 for my AI tool.

examples.title: Draft a SaaSCity listing
examples.description: Create a draft listing on SaaSCity for human review and confirmation via claim link
examples.prompt: Draft a SaaSCity listing for my product and return the claim link so I can review and publish it.
